secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs authentication session cookies. Generated for development; replace with a long random value for stable sessions across restarts.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Enables Marco AI conversational analysis (platform.openai.com). Without it the advisor shows a clear setup notice.

secrets.name: OKX_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Read-only OKX API key for the Spot integration (OKX → Account → API).

secrets.name: OKX_API_PASSPHRASE
secrets.description: Optional. Passphrase set when the OKX API key was created.
